walkthroughs.body_html:
Plant Nutrition — a core area of GCSE Biology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Plant Nutrition brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Plant Nutrition.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Why is the cohesion-tension theory critical for water transport in plants?
options: Hydrogen bonds between water molecules keep the water column unbroken under tension, so transpiration can pull water up from the roots.
Cohesion-tension explains how plants store water in the xylem like a reservoir.
Cohesion-tension describes how water diffuses freely between cells.

mcqs.q: Why are frameshift mutations usually more severe than point substitutions?

Frameshifts only change the codon at the site of the mutation, like a substitution.
